entities.name: Rasulid dynasty
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Rasulid dynasty or Rasulids were a Sunni Yemeni dynasty who ruled Yemen from 1229 to 1454. Generally seen as Oghuz Turkic in origin, their chronicles claimed Arab Ghassanid descent.
